None of these is a row, because a row's place would read as paint order. Filter steps stay in the filter chip, in evaluation order. Hiding is a verb, and what is hidden is on the legend's not-drawn line. A note on a protein shows as a marker on the canvas (TP53's); a note on a row shows as a badge on the row (Community 8 has one). The notes themselves live in the Notes panel.
